messages:
sophie: Urgent: support flagged ~1.2k bulk deprovisions from SCIM that started at ~00:12 UTC. Looks automated by the provisioner. Anyone seeing abnormalities?

devin: What are the errors in the provisioner logs? 401/403/500?

sophie: Main failure is on the introspection call to the IdP: `POST /introspect -> 401 {\"error\":\"invalid_client\"}`. Provisioner treats that as token invalid -> triggers deprovision.

maria-platform: pausing the deprovision queue now so we dont keep ripping accounts. Deploy-bot can you pause scim-deprov-worker?

deploy-bot: job queued: pause-scim-deprov-worker-881 -> 1810000015

linda-ops: we rotated the idp-introspect client cert last night (rotate-certs-2026-06-01). I updated the secret but I did not verify the mounted version on all provisioner hosts. Im checking.

henry-sec: possible causes: wrong secret version, staging cert pushed to prod, or cert expired/subject mismatch. If the IdP rejects client auth it returns invalid_client. Check cert fingerprint and secret version.

devin: run on a failing host: `openssl x509 -in /etc/provisioner/idp-introspect.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256` and compare to Secret Manager version metadata.

sophie: grabbing fingerprint from failing host: `SHA256: 9A:BC:EF:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99`.

linda-ops: confirmed: rotation job accidentally set secret to version `projects/redwood/secrets/idp-introspect-cert/versions/7` which is the staging placeholder. Prod should be version 3. Ill revert to v3.

deploy-bot: start job revert-introspect-cert-to-v3 -> 1810000038

henry-sec: check KMS / secret manager audit: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=secretmanager AND protoPayload.methodName:UpdateSecret" --limit 50` and `gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms AND protoPayload.methodName:asymmetricSign" --limit 50` to ensure no unexpected signing calls.
maria-platform: revert finished and rolling restart of provisioner instances -> 1810000072

sophie: verified introspect now returns 200 from a sample token: `POST /introspect -> 200 {\"active\": true}`. Good.

linda-ops: root cause: rotation job used a templated secret version that defaulted to `7` in the ops account; the value is valid in staging but expired for prod. Ive paused scheduled rotations for idp-introspect-cert until we add preflight checks.

devin: follow-ups: (1) create a circuit breaker so provisioner does not mass deprov on introspection errors (e.g., require N consecutive invalids before deprov), (2) add preflight to rotation job to verify secret.version.labels.environment == prod, (3) add canary that performs an introspect after cert rotation, (4) add alert if introspection 401 rate spikes.
henry-sec: also add an audit rule: any secret.change to `idp-introspect-cert` triggers pager if change made by ops-service-account outside maintenance window.

audit-bot: alert-rule created: secret-change idp-introspect-cert -> pager (owner=eng-security)

sophie: Ill queue a re-provision job for the impacted accounts and coordinate support notifications. We should also reconcile RBAC audit to ensure no manual deprov decisions happened.

maria-platform: note: RBAC audit shows unrelated role edit earlier but not for provisioning principals. Looks like certificate rotation was the likely trigger.

linda-ops: immediate changes Ill make: add secret-version sanity check to the rotation workflow, require explicit `--target-env=prod` flag, and add a smoke test that calls `/introspect` from a canary host.

devin: I will open a PR to add the provisioning circuit breaker and to change auto-deprov behavior to backoff and retry on introspection errors.

henry-sec: add timeline and write a short postmortem. Marking as sev3 (near miss).

sophie: creating incident doc with timeline and remediation tasks, will publish when reprovision job completes. Closing thread after PM published.
